options.title: Shorten the go-pulse crossing
options.approach: In core, shorten the receive-to-transmit go-pulse crossing (xpm_cdc_pulse u_p_go) by dropping its output register, or by replacing the generic pulse crossing with a leaner pulse crossing that keeps two synchroniser flops. The order bus beside the pulse and the frame_src sampling point are re-timed to match. The decision register, the MACs and the PCS are not changed.

gain.basis_note: The crossing adds 4 clocks. Dropping the output register saves 1; one further clock (edge detect merged) is the upper end. Two synchroniser flops are kept, so at most 2 of the 4 clocks are taken. The 4.19 ns slack leaves room for it.
gain.ceiling_basis: the clocks of the touched stages (4)

wall_minutes.basis: iterations x the recorded build time

cost.note: The crossing change and the bus sampling offset must be re-simulated. Then a CDC re-check and a board run follow.
cost.basis: iterations are the generator's estimate (a guess); wall time is those times the recorded Vivado run

options.title: Start the transmit preamble without the s_valid register
options.approach: Merge the frame_src start -> s_valid stage into the mac64_tx preamble register. The MAC takes the preamble from `start` directly, because the preamble word does not depend on frame data and word 0 depends only on configuration. frame_src still raises s_valid for the data words. The PCS, the CRC and poison logic and the clock crossing are not changed.

gain.basis_note: fs_start adds 1 clock, so 1 is the most that can be saved. mac_preamble has only 1.132 ns slack. If the start path then limits the clock, the gain is 0.
gain.ceiling_basis: the clocks of the touched stages (2)

options.title: Merge receive gearbox and descramble
options.approach: In pcs_rx, merge stage B (descramble and decode into x_d, x_c, x_v) into stage A, so that the barrel shift, the 58-bit descramble and the decode sit in front of one register. The block-lock FSM keeps reading the same block registers. The MAC and the decision stage are not changed.

gain.basis_note: rx_descramble adds 1 clock, so 1 is the cap. The stage notes say the 192-bit shifter plus the 64-bit XOR tree did not close at 161 MHz, and the two stages have 1.544 ns and 2.215 ns slack. The result may be 0 if timing fails.
gain.ceiling_basis: the clocks of the touched stages (1)

options.title: Whole-chain latency cut: crossing, transmit start and receive PCS
options.approach: Apply O1, O2 and O3 together: shorten the go-pulse crossing in core, merge fs_start into the MAC preamble register, and merge the pcs_rx stages. Add a timing recovery pass (placement strategy or re-pipelining of non-latency paths) only if the merged paths fail. The rx_mac, decide, tx_encode and gearbox spill stages are not changed.

gain.basis_note: The upper end is the sum of the three upper ends: up to 2 from cross_go, 1 from fs_start/mac_preamble, 1 from rx_descramble, giving 4 of the 11 digital clocks. The low end 1 assumes only the crossing gain holds. The 15 clocks of GT and optics are in the frozen GT and are not reduced.
gain.ceiling_basis: the clocks of the touched stages (7)

wall_minutes.basis: iterations x the recorded build time

cost.note: Three changes, each with its own bench, CDC and timing gates, plus a joint route to close timing.
